implemented_capabilities.capability: Dependency blast radius / upstream dependents / ownership and on-call queries
implemented_capabilities.notes: Parameterized Cypher over Service-DEPENDS_ON*1..N (hops clamped 1..200 via limit() then interpolated; the tool schema further caps at 5), OWNED_BY/HAS_MEMBER/ONCALL_FOR, returning name paths and depth. No weighting, just path enumeration LIMIT 100.

implemented_capabilities.capability: FalkorDB graph-algorithm tool builder (pageRank, WCC, label propagation, betweenness)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Builds CALL algo.pageRank(label, rel), algo.WCC({nodeLabels,relationshipTypes}), algo.labelPropagation({...}), algo.betweenness({...}) strings with YIELD columns matching FalkorDB (componentId/communityId) and documents signature quirks; unit-tested for exact output. Label/rel are string-interpolated with only single-quote escaping (see security findings).

implemented_capabilities.capability: Decision lineage written on action: Action -> Decision -> Evidence -> entity
implemented_capabilities.notes: Paging resolves the on-call Person by graph traversal, attaches to the open Incident (or auto-opens one), only ever escalates severity, creates (Action)-[:AUTHORIZED_BY]->(Decision)-[:BASED_ON]->(Evidence)-[:ABOUT]->(entity) and an episodic Memory. Provenance writes are best-effort (failure sets provenanceRecorded=false and the page still goes out). Real paging/Slack are simulated: only graph records are written.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Graph-native three-type agent memory (episodic, semantic, procedural) with run provenance
implemented_capabilities.notes: Memory nodes {kind,key,value,at} linked [:ABOUT] entities and [:WROTE] from the AgentRun; every tool call becomes a TraceStep with TOUCHES edges. Recall is Cypher filtering by kind/entity/substring ordered by timestamp, not vector search; no supersession or expiry.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Three-stage agent pipeline (triage, investigator, commander) via AI SDK tool calling
implemented_capabilities.notes: Three generateText calls with bounded steps (4/8/6) and different tool subsets; the commander may invoke state-changing tools (page_on_call, create_incident, resolve_incident, write_memory) with no human approval gate. Inter-stage state is passed through text plus TraceStep nodes.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Deterministic 'graph replay' fallback when no LLM key is present
implemented_capabilities.notes: Runs real Cypher and PageRank but the scenario is hard-coded to checkout-api / payments-gateway / ledger / INC-1180 and the narrative strings are canned; any question containing 'who', 'page' or 'on-call' triggers a SEV1 page of payments-gateway regardless of what was asked.

Regex denylist (CREATE|MERGE|SET|DELETE|REMOVE|DROP|DETACH|ALTER|FOREACH|GRAPH.) after stripping comments/strings plus single-statement check, with 200-row/12-column response caps; it uses graph.query (not RO_QUERY), so it relies entirely on the regex and CALL procedures other than algo.* are not blocked.

implemented_capabilities.capability: MCP server over the same tool registry (stateless Streamable HTTP and stdio)
implemented_capabilities.notes: One tool definition set is adapted to both AI SDK and MCP; every handler writes a TraceStep. The HTTP endpoint is stateless and has no authentication.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Per-tenant graph isolation, seeding and free-tier keep-alive
implemented_capabilities.notes: Graph name unspool_<sanitized tenant>; seedGraph deletes then rebuilds the synthetic 'company' (services, teams, people, documents, incidents, memories). Keep-alive endpoint is secret-gated only when CRON_SECRET is set.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Graph contract tests (schema vs Cypher usage)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Tests assert that every relationship type traversed in the codebase is created somewhere and vice versa, preventing silent dead joins.

graph_models_and_cypher: Per-tenant graph unspool_<tenant>. Domain: Service(name,tier,language,repo), Team, Person, Cluster, Document(kind runbook|adr|slack|ticket|postmortem), Incident(id,severity,status,openedAt), Alert; edges DEPENDS_ON{latencyMs,critical}, OWNED_BY, RUNS_IN, HAS_MEMBER, ONCALL_FOR, REFERENCES, AFFECTS, FIRES_ON. Agent layer: Memory(kind,key,value,at)-[:ABOUT]->any; AgentRun-[:TOOK_STEP]->TraceStep-[:TOUCHES]->any; AgentRun-[:WROTE]->Memory; Action-[:TARGETS]->Incident; Action-[:AUTHORIZED_BY]->Decision-[:BASED_ON]->Evidence-[:ABOUT]->any; Tenant. Cypher is mostly parameterized; hop counts and algorithm label/rel names are interpolated. Uses FalkorDB-native algo.pageRank/WCC/labelPropagation/betweenness, shortestPath((a)-[*]-(b)), id() joins. No APOC/GDS. Note: the `(MATCH (e) WHERE e.name = ref OR e.id = ref)` pattern in actions.ts/memory.ts is an unlabeled full scan.
algorithms: Bounded downstream/upstream DEPENDS_ON path enumeration (<=5 hops from tools, LIMIT 100) in queries.ts:blastRadius/dependentsOf
FalkorDB native pageRank / WCC / label propagation / betweenness invoked and parsed in queries.ts:runAlgorithm
Unlabeled undirected shortestPath between two named entities ('red thread') in queries.ts:shortestPathBetween
Severity-escalate-only update and on-call resolution by ONCALL_FOR traversal in actions.ts:actPageOnCall
backend_interfaces: Next.js route handlers: POST /api/agent, POST /api/cypher, POST/GET /api/mcp, POST/GET /api/seed, GET /api/graph, GET /api/analysis, GET /api/runs, GET /api/health, GET /api/cron/keepalive
CLI scripts: bun run seed, bun run mcp (stdio), bun run verify
frontend_interfaces: React components: GraphCanvas (@xyflow/react), ChatPanel, TraceTimeline, MemoryPanel, AnalysisPanel, CypherConsole; page.tsx dashboard
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Triage -> Investigator -> Commander stages sharing one FalkorDB graph as the inter-agent state (TraceStep/Evidence/Memory nodes); three-kind Memory recalled by Cypher; action tools write Action/Decision/Evidence provenance. No approval gating, memory expiry or contradiction handling.
tests_present: Seven bun test files (about 60 tests): cypher-lint, graph-contract, mcp, query-builders, readonly, schema, seed. Several validate pure functions (buildAlgorithmCall, isReadOnlyCypher, schema/relationship contract); seed/mcp tests may require a configured FalkorDB; scripts/verify.ts is a live end-to-end check (not executed).
security_findings: src/lib/graph/queries.ts:105-110,117-118 - algorithm label/relType are interpolated into Cypher with only single-quote escaping (backslash not escaped), so an input ending in backslash-quote can break out of the literal; the values are reachable from the run_algorithm tool (LLM- or MCP-client-supplied, registry.ts:122-140)

src/app/api/mcp/route.ts:43-92 - unauthenticated MCP endpoint exposes side-effecting tools (page_on_call, create_incident, resolve_incident, write_memory) against any tenant chosen via ?tenant= / X-Tenant-Id
src/app/api/seed/route.ts:12-26 and src/lib/graph/seed.ts:21 - unauthenticated POST deletes and re-seeds a tenant graph (graph.delete())
src/app/api/agent/route.ts:22-58 - unauthenticated LLM-invoking endpoint (cost abuse); tenant ids are sanitized to [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64} before becoming graph names (good)

src/lib/graph/readonly.ts:12-14,43-45 and src/app/api/cypher/route.ts:54-62 - read-only protection is a regex denylist executed with graph.query rather than GRAPH.RO_QUERY; unreviewed procedure calls other than writes (e.g. CALL db.* or algo.* with write semantics) are not blocked
src/app/api/cron/keepalive/route.ts:29-35 - bearer-secret check is skipped entirely when CRON_SECRET is unset

src/lib/agent/provider.ts:14-38 - LLM API key read from OPENROUTER_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY/AGENT_API_KEY env, sent to a configurable AGENT_BASE_URL; .env.example holds only placeholders (no real secret found)
src/lib/agent/actions.ts:111-122 and memory.ts:34-38 - MATCH (e) WHERE e.name = ref OR e.id = ref is an unindexed full scan on every evidence/memory link (performance risk on large graphs)
src/lib/agent/orchestrator.ts:92-95,243-251 - replay fallback can SEV1-page a hard-coded service for any question containing 'who'/'page' (misleading action record)
duplicates_or_overlaps: Overlaps blast-radius traversal / incident RCA / on-call routing (blastradius, clearpath, NexusGraph) and agent memory; its Action->Decision->Evidence provenance overlaps hound-aml's evidence ledger (less strict).
evidence_drift_relevance: MEDIUM - writes explicit decision lineage (Action AUTHORIZED_BY Decision BASED_ON Evidence ABOUT entity), per-step TraceStep Cypher, memory typed by kind with WROTE provenance, and a schema-vs-Cypher contract test; it has no approval gating, validity intervals, supersession, or invalidation when evidence changes.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: A compact decision-lineage schema plus the verified FalkorDB algorithm call signatures (config-map procedures, YIELD column names) and a relationship-type contract test idea that can be re-implemented in Python for Kairos.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB; Node/Bun + Next.js if used as-is; OpenRouter/OpenAI key only for the live agent

strategy_rationale: TypeScript/Next.js on Vercel does not merge into the Python FastAPI Kairos; borrow the Action/Decision/Evidence provenance schema, algorithm-call signatures and schema-contract test concept, and avoid the regex read-only gate and unauthenticated MCP side-effecting tools.
